script = '''\
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# 1. OCR the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== OCR TEXT ===")
print(text)
print("================")

# 2. Write the extracted text into an Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Put each line of the OCR output into its own row in column A
for row_idx, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1, value=line)

output_path = "output/invoice_ocr.xlsx"
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved Excel file to {output_path}")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_to_excel.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./ocr_to_excel.py")
print(result)

info = await get_file_info("./output/invoice_ocr.xlsx")
print(info)
